en: A black‑and‑white commemorative military postcard arranged as a collage. At the top center is a portrait of Kaiser Wilhelm, flanked by other uniformed officers and German imperial symbols. Beneath them are small photographs of barracks buildings, a guardhouse, landscapes, and regimental scenes, each labeled in German. At the bottom is a stag's head with crossed rifles and a banner containing German text marking the 100‑year anniversary of a Jäger (rifle) battalion from Hirschberg in Silesia.
